breakpoints.note: First project-code statement that consumes the attacker-controlled PDF /ToUnicode stream and materializes it into a GooString buffer for CMap parsing.

parseCMap1 relies on tok2 holding a NUL-terminated token, but it never initializes bytes beyond the current token length. When a malformed CMap produces a short token, strcmp on tok2 reads past the written bytes into the uninitialized stack tail. A correct fix would zero-initialize the token buffers before use or avoid fixed-length keyword comparisons on partially initialized storage.
